items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewer states: 'You knew him personally. You lived – I saw an account that you lived with him for a couple of months... Is that right?' The interviewee does not confirm this specific claim of personal acquaintance or cohabitation, but instead provides a detailed professional and stylistic a

ctx.x: But he loved drums, having Buddy and Gene in the band for years, Davey Tough, Big Sid Catlett. Jo Jones did some recording with him. We devised an idea. I told him I should have some kind of idea in the theaters that people – ordinary laymen – hear that sound. They don’t know I’ve got two bass drums. So I told Tommy I need to make a table to put my drum set on, and it goes around. He said, “That’s it.” So he had one made. That was a big thing at the Strand Theater.
